advancedArguments.name: existingNeedName
advancedArguments.description: The name (or partial name) of an already-existing training need category to attach this application to, e.g. 'Database & Data Management' - matches case-insensitively against the category list from getSelfTrainingNeeds' existingNeedCategories. Use this when the employee picks one of the categories already on file (UAC 3.2 - Training Need Type = 'Existing Need' on the real form) rather than describing something new. If more than one category matches, the tool returns status AMBIGUOUS with the candidates - ask the employee to pick one and retry with the exact name. Either existingNeedName or newNeedName must be provided, not both. Not required when calling purely to list ongoing goals (enableGoalObjectives: true, no goalTitle yet).

Either existingNeedName or newNeedName must be provided, not both. Not required when calling purely to list ongoing goals (enableGoalObjectives: true, no goalTitle yet).

advancedArguments.name: newNeedDescription

advancedArguments.name: enableGoalObjectives
advancedArguments.description: Set true when the employee wants to link their training need's objective to one of their ongoing performance goals but hasn't picked which one yet (mirrors the real form's 'Enable Goal Objectives' checkbox, which loads the goal list straight into the Objectives dropdown). When true and goalTitle is not yet provided, this tool returns status GOALS_LISTED with the employee's current ongoing goals (ongoingGoals: [{goalTitle, goalCode}]) instead of submitting anything - present the titles, get the employee's choice, then call this tool again with goalTitle set to their exact choice (plus existingNeedName/newNeedName and the other required fields, since nothing is submitted on this listing call). Do not set this once goalTitle is already known - pass goalTitle directly instead. This is always safe to call on its own since it only reads the goal list, nothing is written.

advancedArguments.name: objective
advancedArguments.description: The objective of this training need, in the employee's own words - OR link to one of the employee's ongoing performance goals via goalTitle instead (the real form's 'Enable Goal Objectives' checkbox switches this from free text to a goal picker - only one of the two is used). Whether objective/goalTitle is actually mandatory is a per-client Training & Development configuration setting (IsObjectiveMandatory) and can change - do not assume it's required and do not insist on it upfront if the employee doesn't have one in mind yet. Call this tool with whatever is known; if ValidateNeedApplication rejects the submission with 'Please specify the objective.', that confirms it's mandatory for this org - ask the employee for it then and call this tool again with the same arguments plus objective (or goalTitle) filled in.

advancedArguments.name: goalTitle
advancedArguments.description: The title of one of the employee's ongoing performance goals to link this training need's objective to, instead of writing a free-text objective (the real form's 'Enable Goal Objectives' checkbox, switching the Objective field from a text box to a goal-picker dropdown). Matches case-insensitively against the employee's live ongoing-goals list. If you don't already know the employee's exact ongoing goal titles, first call this tool with enableGoalObjectives: true and no goalTitle to get the current list (status GOALS_LISTED) - do not guess or invent a title. If more than one ongoing goal shares that exact title (confirmed to happen in real data), the tool returns AMBIGUOUS and it's simpler to just provide the objective argument instead. Do not use this unless the employee explicitly wants to link the need to an existing goal - a plain-text objective is the default path.

advancedArguments.name: removeAttachments
advancedArguments.description: Whenever the user attaches a file, call this tool again on that same turn, with whatever arguments are already known - the chat hands this tool a file's contents only on the turn it was attached, so never just acknowledge a file, ask a question first, or call another tool instead; a file this tool never sees on its own turn has to be attached again. File names to take off this application, exactly as shown in the preview's attachments list or as attached in the chat - e.g. when the employee says 'remove images.png'. Attachments are never passed as arguments: every file the employee attaches in the chat is picked up automatically and added to the application (several files are allowed, in one message or across several). A removed file stays out on later calls even if the chat keeps listing it, so there is no need to send it again; attaching it again brings it back. A file this tool rejected for its type or size is already left out - never put it here. Never tell the employee to start a new chat to get rid of a file.

advancedArguments.name: replaceAttachments
advancedArguments.description: Set true when the employee attaches a new file to REPLACE the earlier one(s) ('use this document instead', 'replace the attachment with this'), on the call for the message that carries the new file: the file(s) attached in that message become the only attachments and every earlier file is left out. Leave unset when they are adding another file - files are added by default. If the new file was attached in an earlier message, use removeAttachments with the old file's name instead.

Leave unset when they are adding another file - files are added by default. If the new file was attached in an earlier message, use removeAttachments with the old file's name instead.

advancedArguments.name: confirmed
advancedArguments.description: Set true only after the employee has reviewed a summary of this exact application (need, objective/goal, relevance to job, benefits, attachments) and explicitly agreed to submit it. Leave unset/false on the first call - the tool returns status CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with a preview and the server's own confirmation prompt (mirrors the real form's 'Are you sure you want to submit this training need?' dialog, shown right before Save) instead of submitting anything. Nothing is validated or saved until this is true (attached files are uploaded as soon as they are attached, as on the real form, but only become part of the application when it is saved). Call this tool again with confirmed:true and the exact same arguments once the employee agrees.
